text:
Mason Rook has his EYES on the NXT Title!! 👀

@MasonRook_wwe https://t.co/0icyfOviB8

transcript.text: Emphatic return earlier tonight attacking the NXT Champion Grayson Waller. Is it safe to say that you're back?
You're damn right I'm back Blake. I busted my ass off to be back ahead of schedule.
I'm picking up right where I left off and going after the NXT Championship.
Two months ago I earned my spot to be number one contender and unfortunately life had other plans.
I had to sit on the sidelines, I had to watch EK Prosper, Tony D'Angelo, hell even CM Punk try and take the title from Grayson.
And Grayson escaped those guys, but let me tell you for free, he is not going to escape me.
Because I am back and it doesn't matter who is in front of me.
You saw Shiloh Hill, he made his intentions clear, so did I.
And Zilla Fatu, I'm going to be paying attention real closely to what you have to say tonight.
Because there is no one who is going to stop me from becoming NXT Champion.
